children: CBOT grain futures are pulling back after touching multi-year highs last week. "The trend as of this morning seems to be one of correction," says Charlie Sernatinger of Marex in a note. He adds that temperatures are expected to be hotter this week, which comes as crops hit the late side of their growth cycle and harvesting draws closer. Most-active CBOT corn is down 0.2%, while soybeans fall 0.5% and wheat is off 2%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
